decisions.reason: The cobot loading system builds on the established machining offer and fits the firm's automation strategy, so it costs little to keep while its market uptake is still uncertain.
The dual-table loading system is a low-cost accessory to existing machines whose value is still unresolved after a 2024 launch, so keeping the option open is worthwhile.
The dispensing machine is distant from the core business and costlier to carry, but its own web page and Red Dot award are positive early signals, so the option has not yet resolved negatively.
